# netbox_ipsec_proposal (Resource)

An IPSec proposal (vpn.ipsecproposal): the algorithms and lifetimes of one IPSec security association.

From the [official documentation](https://netboxlabs.com/docs/netbox/models/vpn/ipsecproposal/):

> An [IPSec](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/IPsec) proposal defines a set of parameters used in negotiating security associations for IPSec tunnels. IPSec proposals defined in NetBox can be referenced by [IPSec policies](https://netboxlabs.com/docs/netbox/models/vpn/ipsecpolicy/), which are in turn employed by [IPSec profiles](https://netboxlabs.com/docs/netbox/models/vpn/ipsecprofile/).

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "netbox_ipsec_proposal" "test" {
  name                     = "test-ipsec-proposal"
  encryption_algorithm     = "aes-256-cbc"
  authentication_algorithm = "hmac-sha256"
  sa_lifetime_seconds      = 3600
  sa_lifetime_data         = 102400
  description              = "test-description"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String)

### Optional

- `authentication_algorithm` (String) Authentication algorithm; not needed for GCM encryption algorithms. NetBox does not allow clearing it once set; leaving it unset keeps the current value. One of: hmac-sha1, hmac-sha256, hmac-sha384, hmac-sha512, hmac-md5.
- `comments` (String)
- `custom_fields` (Map of String) Custom field values by field name. Every value is a string; NetBox coerces numbers and booleans. A key removed from the map is cleared in NetBox (set {} to clear all).
- `description` (String)
- `encryption_algorithm` (String) Encryption algorithm. NetBox requires an encryption algorithm, an authentication algorithm, or both, and does not allow clearing either once set; leaving it unset keeps the current value. One of: aes-128-cbc, aes-128-gcm, aes-192-cbc, aes-192-gcm, aes-256-cbc, aes-256-gcm, 3des-cbc, des-cbc.
- `owner_id` (Number) Id of the owner the object is assigned to.
- `sa_lifetime_data` (Number) Security association lifetime in kilobytes.
- `sa_lifetime_seconds` (Number) Security association lifetime in seconds.
- `tags` (Set of String) Slugs of the tags assigned to the object (the provider's default_tags are added on top, see tags_all).

### Read-Only

- `created` (String)
- `id` (Number) NetBox id.
- `last_updated` (String)
- `tags_all` (Set of String) Slugs of all tags on the object, including the provider's default_tags.
- `url` (String)

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `id` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = netbox_ipsec_proposal.test
  id = "123"
}
```

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import netbox_ipsec_proposal.test 123
```
